topic.title: Article 4 Directions / Permitted Development Rights / Compensation
topic.source_contract: specified permitted-development right, defined area, justification, direction procedure, notice and consultation, confirmation, effective date, compensation exposure, planning application requirement, enforcement and current map evidence

scope_guards: A policy intention is not treated as a made Article 4 direction.
A consultation draft is not treated as a confirmed direction.
A map without the operative schedule is not treated as proof of withdrawn rights.
An Article 4 direction is not treated as a prohibition on development.
A direction effective date is not treated as evidence that works occurred after it.
A planning application requirement is not treated as planning refusal.
Absence of an application is not treated as enforcement confirmation.
No score or promotion is written without the exact direction, map, effective date, development timing and decision evidence.
